card.name: Just before MBq and REMS letters
card.fires_on: Points where the next text is expected to begin with the letter M: the opening bracket after a spelled-out megabecquerel, the 7 in 37 before MBq, and RE in REMS web addresses.

modes.label: Bracket before MBq
modes.description: An opening parenthesis right after a spelled-out unit or procedure name, where an abbreviation starting with M follows.

modes.label: The 7 in 37 MBq
modes.description: The digit 7 inside the number 37 in radioactivity doses, just before MBq.
modes.example: MBq/kg to 7.4 MBq/kg (0.1 mCi/kg to 0.2 mCi/kg) Minimum 3<<7>> MBq (1 mCi) Maximum

modes.label: RE in REMS links
modes.description: The letters RE inside web addresses for REMS programs, right before MS.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens starting with M, so it seems to reduce the chance that an M comes next.
card.plain: It fires where an M-starting unit or acronym such as MBq, MPI or MS is about to come next.
